description: LumiMusic is an all-in-one AI music creation platform that transforms your ideas, text prompts, or lyrics into complete vocal and instrumental tracks—no production experience required. Beyond generation, LumiMusic offers a full suite of editing tools to remix, extend, add or remove vocals, separate stems, analyze audio, and convert tracks into editable MIDI. You can organize your creations in a personal library, play them in a sleek web player, or share dedicated listening pages. Eligible plans
